name: Hamster Kyouto no Kaine-kun
original_name: ハムスター狂徒の飼音くん
source:
He looks pleasant on the outside, but on the inside he's a total ham-dere (hamster yandere)! A hamster comedy featuring an interview with Kaine Noka, a slightly unhinged hamster fanatic!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kaine.html]official website[/url]]
